request.content: You are a helpful assistant that translates programming worked examples into other natural languages, maintaining both technical accuracy and the original code formatting.

[[TASK-DEFINITION]] You will be given a worked example. Your job is to translate the [[WORKED-EXAMPLE]] according to the [[TASK-INSTRUCTIONS]]. [[WORKED-EXAMPLE]] [[PROGRAM-NAME]] Printing Consecutive Numbers Starting from Zero (Case 1) [[PROGRAM-DESCRIPTION]] Construct a program that prints a sequence of numbers from 0 (inclusive) to 10 (exclusive). [[SOURCE-CODE]] [[LINE01]] #Step 1: Iterate through the numbers in the sequence [[LINE02]] for num in range(10): [[LINE03]] #Step 1.1: Print each number in the sequence [[LINE04]] print(num) [[LINE-EXPLANATIONS]] [[LINE02.EXPL1]] We need to repeat printing the numbers that are in a sequence from 0 (inclusive) to 10 (exclusive). To do this, we need to use a loop structure. We use for loops instead of a while loop because we need to repeat the loop 10 times, and for loops are best-suited in cases like this when we know ahead of time the number of times that we need to repeat the loop.

We use the range function because it generates a sequence of numbers for the for loop. Here, we want a sequence that starts at 0 with every integer number up to but not including 10. We get this sequence by calling the function range(10). [[LINE02.EXPL2]] We do not need to provide the integer value at which the sequence begins because the sequence returned by the range function start at 0 (inclusive) by default.

Note that all statements inside the loop need to be indented with respect to the loop header. [[LINE04.EXPL1]] This statement prints each number in the sequence to the default standard output stream. The printed text is followed by the end-of-line character at the end. [[LINE-DISTRACTORS]] [[DIST1.LC]] for num in range(9): [[DIST2.LC]] for num in range(11): [[DIST3.LC]] for num in range(12): [[DIST4.LC]] for num in range(8): [[TASK-INSTRUCTIONS]] Translate the given worked example into Arabic. Be sure to specifically translate the sections labeled [[PROGRAM-NAME]], [[PROGRAM-DESCRIPTION]], [[SOURCE-CODE]], [[LINE-EXPLANATIONS]], and [[LINE-DISTRACTORS]]. In the [[SOURCE-CODE]] section, translate ONLY user-defined string-literals and comments; make sure they are ASCII-folded (i.e., remove any accents or non-ASCII characters). Preserve the original format and Do NOT add, remove, or change any content beyond translation.

[[SOURCE-CODE]] [[LINE01]] #Al-khatwa 1: tikrar 'abr al-a'dad fi al-tasalsul [[LINE02]] for num in range(10): [[LINE03]] #Al-khatwa 1.1: itba' kull raqam fi al-tasalsul [[LINE04]] print(num) [[LINE-EXPLANATIONS]] [[LINE02.EXPL1]] نحتاج إلى تكرار طباعة الأعداد الموجودة في تسلسل من 0 (شامل) إلى 10 (غير شامل). لتحقيق ذلك، نحتاج إلى استخدام بنية حلقة. نستخدم حلقة for بدلاً من حلقة while لأننا نحتاج إلى تكرار الحلقة 10 مرات، وحلقات for هي الأنسب في مثل هذه الحالات عندما نعرف مسبقاً عدد المرات التي نحتاج فيها إلى تكرار الحلقة.

نستخدم الدالة range لأنها تولد تسلسلاً من الأعداد للاستخدام في حلقة for. هنا، نريد تسلسلاً يبدأ من 0 ويشمل كل عدد صحيح حتى لكن لا يشمل 10. نحصل على هذا التسلسل باستدعاء الدالة range(10). [[LINE02.EXPL2]] لا نحتاج إلى تزويد قيمة صحيحة لبداية التسلسل لأن التسلسل الذي تُرجعه الدالة range يبدأ من 0 (شامل) افتراضياً.
